stops.title: The church addressed
stops.text: A small, once prosperous town in the Lycus Valley where Epaphras started the church. Philemon, Onesimus, and Archippus were probably from here.

stops.title: The neighbor church
stops.text: A wealthy city a few miles away. Paul asks that his letter be read there and that the Colossians read the letter from Laodicea.

stops.title: The third city
stops.text: A spa town across the valley, where Epaphras also worked hard for the believers.
